clauses.text: Eligibility criteria to appear for POLYCET-2026 9
3.0 ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA TO APPEAR FOR POLYCET a) The candidate shall be an Indian National.
c) The candidates should have passed S.S.C

d) Candidates belonging to NIOS/TOSS/CBSE/ICSE/OTHER Examinations recognized as equivalent to SSC by Telangana State SHOULD HAVE PASSED ALL THE SUBJECTS, including Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, with a minimum of 35% Marks in each subject.
3.1 ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA TO APPEAR FOR PJTAU.

c) Candidate should have passed SSC Examination conducted by State Board of Secondary Education, T.S./A.P. or any other examination recognized as equivalent thereto by the Board of Secondary Education, T.S./A.P. such as Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), Indian Council for Secondary…

d) Candidates belonging to NIOS/TOSS/APOSS/CBSE/ICSE/OTHER Examinations recognized as equivalent to S.S.C by Telangana State SHOULD HAVE PASSED ALL THE SUBJECTS including Mathematics, Biology, Physics, and Chemistry with a minimum of 35% Marks in each subject.
3.2 ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA TO APPEAR FOR PVNRTVU a) The Candidate shall be an Indian National.

f) Candidate should have passed SSC Examination conducted by State Board of Secondary Education, Telangana or any other examination recognized as equivalent thereto by the Board of Secondary Education, Telangana such as Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), Indian Council for Secondary…

g) The candidates belonging to NIOS/TOSS/CBSE/ICSE/Other Examinations recognized as equivalent to S.S.C. by Telangana State SHOULD HAVE PASSED ALL THE SUBJECTS, including Mathematics, Biology, Physics, and Chemistry, with a minimum of 35% Marks in each subject.
9.0 RESULTS OF POLYCET FOR POLYTECHNICS - MPC Rank a) The minimum marks for declaring a candidate to have passed in the Entrance examination shall be thirty percent i.e., 36 marks out of 120.

9.1 RESULTS OF POLYCET FOR POLYTECHNICS – MBiPC Rank a) The minimum marks for declaring a candidate to have passed the Entrance examination shall be thirty percent i.e., 36 marks in Maths (60/2), Biology, Physics, and Chemistry put together.

negative_marking.value: Half of the marks assigned for each wrong answer
